boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten current, under-21-friendly Oberlin activities with no admission or purchase required.

cards.title: Browse the Allen Memorial Art Museum
cards.subtitle: 87 N. Main St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Meet up to walk the galleries at your own pace, then use a favorite work as the prompt for a low-key conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free public museum visit with collections, exhibitions, and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin states that the Allen Memorial Art Museum has been free and open to the public since 1917 and remains so today.
cards.access_notes: Open to visitors of all ages; check the museum’s visit information before going.

cards.title: Go to a public observing night
cards.subtitle: Oberlin College Observatory, Peters Hall
cards.notes: Bring a friend to an open house and allow time for the small observatory’s capacity limit and possible weather changes.
cards.short_summary: A telescope-and-planetarium open house on select school-year Fridays.
cards.evidence_claim: The observatory says all of its public open houses are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Generally held on first and third Friday evenings during the school year; confirm the Events Calendar. Capacity past the door is 35.

cards.title: Take a loop on the EBus
cards.subtitle: Fixed route through Oberlin, including Stevenson Hall and the AJLC
cards.notes: Use the city’s route map to choose a stop, then ride together to a park, library, or campus destination without a fare.
cards.short_summary: A city-operated electric shuttle serving campus and community stops.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Oberlin describes the EBus as a free electric public transportation option and says it is free to ride.
cards.access_notes: Runs Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; the city lists holiday service exceptions and publishes the route and wait times.

cards.title: Watch a Yeomen football home game
cards.subtitle: Oberlin varsity athletics
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar for a home date, invite a group, and arrive ready to watch without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission way to follow Oberlin varsity football in season.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin says it hosts more than 100 varsity home games yearly and that all are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm opponent, venue, and weather details on the athletic events calendar before leaving.
